headword: チャンネル{登録|とうろく}

definitions.gloss: channel subscription; subscribing to a channel
definitions.explanation: Subscribing to a content creator's channel on a video platform such as YouTube, so that the viewer is notified of new uploads and the channel appears in their subscription feed. Heard constantly in YouTuber videos in the standard appeal to viewers.

examples.japanese: チャンネル{登録|とうろく}をお{願|ねが}いします。
{面白|おもしろ}い{動画|どうが}だったので、チャンネル{登録|とうろく}した。
examples.english: The video was interesting, so I subscribed to the channel.

examples.japanese: チャンネル{登録|とうろく}{者数|しゃすう}が10{万人|まんにん}を{超|こ}えると{銀|ぎん}の{盾|たて}がもらえる。
examples.english: When the number of channel subscribers exceeds 100,000, you receive a silver play button.

notes:
A set phrase coined with the spread of YouTube in Japan. The full appeal phrase チャンネル{登録|とうろく}{よろしく}お{願|ねが}いします is one of the most-heard sentences in Japanese YouTube videos.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}する: to subscribe to the channel
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}を{解除|かいじょ}する: to unsubscribe from the channel
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}{者|しゃ}: subscriber(s) (of a channel)
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}{者数|しゃすう}: subscriber count
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}ボタン: subscribe button
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}{よろしく}お{願|ねが}いします: 'Please subscribe!' (standard YouTuber closing line)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {購読|こうどく}: subscription (reading/content) — often used for paid subscriptions to magazines, newspapers, or online publications
- {定期購読|ていきこうどく}: regular subscription (print or digital) — emphasizes recurring payment
- フォロー: follow — used on social media (Twitter, Instagram); a lighter, non-notification-based version of following

USAGE:
チャンネル{登録|とうろく} is specifically used for video channels (YouTube and similar platforms). For social media following, フォロー is used instead. For paid subscriptions, サブスク (short for サブスクリプション) or {定期購読|ていきこうどく} is more common.
